app.docstring: Test adding multiple variants of a bundle product to cart. 1. Search bundle product, go to PDP, select option 1 from both dropdowns, add to cart 2. Navigate back, search same product, select option 2

app.name: test_uae_cart_configurable_multiple_variants
app.title: Cart: Add multiple variants of configurable product and verify quantity update
app.docstring: Test adding multiple variants of a configurable product to cart. 1. Search configurable product, go to PDP, select '0 to 3 Months', add to cart 2. Navigate back, search same product, select '6 Months'

app.name: test_app_uae_cart_remove_item_with_applied_coupon
app.title: Remove item from cart with applied coupon and verify totals recalculate
app.docstring: Verify that user can remove an item when coupon is applied and totals recalculate correctly.

app.name: test_uae_checkout_cc_no_coupon
app.title: Successful user checkout in uae with CC no coupon
app.docstring: 1. Search specific product through search 2. Navigate to the PDP of the 1st product from PLP 3. Click add to bag for this item 4. Go to cart 5. Proceed to checkout 6. Pay using CC w/no coupon

app.title: Successful user checkout in UAE with COD no coupon
app.docstring: 1. Login to App 2. Click on Explore 3. Click on Search and enter: Search > Category 11 - Fashion > press enter 4. Add first product on plp page 5. Click on cart 6. Click on Checkout button 7. Find pay

app.name: test_uae_guest_checkout_login_bottom_sheet_and_place_order
app.docstring: Guest checkout flow (parametrized by product type): 1. Precondition: Login, clear cart, sign out 2. As guest, search and add product to cart 3. Navigate to cart and verify item present 4. Tap checkout

app.name: test_customer_can_search_brand
app.title: Customer user can open brand page from search suggestions
app.docstring: 1. Ensure the home page is visible 2. Type a brand name in the search bar 3. Select the matching brand suggestion 4. Confirm the brand page opens

app.name: test_customer_can_search_product_in_specific_category
app.title: Customer user can open category page from search suggestions
app.docstring: Test that customer can search for products in a specific category using category suggestions. Steps: 1. Navigate to the home page 2. Search for a term and select category suggestion 3. Verify category

app.name: test_app_explore_screen_elements_and_navigate_to_account
app.title: Explore screen shows key elements and navigates to Account
app.docstring: 1. Close all popups and select country 2. Verify explore screen key elements (feed, search header, bottom nav tabs) 3. Tap the Account tab in bottom navigation 4. Verify the Account screen loads
